Package com.siemens.pki.cmpracomponent.configuration

Interface VerificationContext

public interface VerificationContext
an instance of an VerificationContext provides all attributes required to verify external credentials. For technical background have a look to the Java PKI Programmer's Guide. The VerificationContext is internally used to set up an PKIX CertPathBuilder for certificate chain validation

      default byte[] getSharedSecret(byte[] senderKID)
      provide a shared secret if trust validation based on a shared secret should be supported for the given client senderKID

      Returns:
